nodes.text: Let $h(n)$ count the number of incongruent sets of $n$ points in $\mathbb{R}^2$ which minimise the diameter subject to the constraint that $d(x,y)\geq 1$ for all points $x\neq y$. Is it true that $h(n)\to \infty$?

#103 : [Er94b] geometry | distances It is not even known whether $h(n)\geq 2$ for all large $n$. See also [99] .
